name: Generate structured image prompts for generative AI
description: Users asked to generate four distinct image prompts for a generative AI tool, each based on a specific concept and adhering to detailed structural, formatting, and stylistic guidelines. The requests varied in subject matter, ranging from fantastical creatures and cultural scenes to abstract concepts, but consistently required the output to follow a strict template with specific parameters like aspect ratio and style.
